overview: A small order-management UI consisting of two connected screens: an Order Summary view for reviewing a single order's full detail, and a Customer Order History view for browsing all orders placed by a customer.
component_notes: Both screens reuse a consistent .screen__header/.screen__nav-link pattern and a shared .status-badge component. Informal, observed pattern only.
design_rationale_highlights: Two-column layout for Order Summary chosen because UME-001 aggregates Order+Customer+LineItem
Plain <a href> navigation preferred over JS click handlers for easier flow-diagram verification
